requirements.text: Patients should be able to book or cancel appointments easily with just a few clicks.
There should be a clear confirmation message after booking or cancelling an appointment.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions with a simple option, like a button.
There should be a way for patients to check the status of their prescription requests.
The portal must ensure patient data is secure and private.
The portal must be user-friendly, especially for patients who may not be very tech-savvy.
